QUOTE: "The library itself contains no thread creation." and "with the shipped defaults, the library runs no threads of its own and takes no locks."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the library creates no threads by default, but it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main. It lists `handle_ssl_connection` in `ssl_pthread_server.c` as a live thread entry point, which contradicts the item.
